title: Rhythm Face DJ Battle
description: The player controls a giant animated DJ head (facecap) that must catch BoomBox speakers falling from the sky by opening and closing its mouth at the right timing. Each caught BoomBox triggers a bass explosion effect and scores points, while missed boxes reduce health. The player must survive 8 waves of increasing speed to win.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) implementing a rhythm-catching game. Load 'shared_assets/facecap.glb' as a large DJ head centered at (0, -1, 0) scaled to 3x, and 'shared_assets/BoomBox.glb' as collectible speakers scaled to 80x. Camera is positioned at (0, 2, 7) looking at the origin with a dark purple-to-black gradient background using a vertical gradient on the scene background via CSS. Add three-point lighting: a warm spotlight from above, a blue point light on the left, and a pink point light on the right for a club atmosphere. The facecap head rotates left/right following the mouse X position using raycasting on an invisible ground plane, smoothly interpolating with lerp. When the player clicks, the head's mouth opens by finding the jaw bone or mouth-related morph target in the facecap model and animating it open for 0.4 seconds then closing. BoomBoxes spawn at random X positions (-4 to 4) at Y=8 and fall downward at increasing speeds. Collision detection checks if a BoomBox is within 1.5 units of the head center AND the mouth is currently open — if both conditions met, the BoomBox is caught: remove it, increment score, flash the screen white briefly, and scale-pulse the head to 1.2x then back. If a BoomBox falls below Y=-3 uncaught, decrement health. Display an HTML overlay HUD showing: score, health bar (starts at 5), current wave number (1-8), and boxes remaining in wave. Each wave spawns 3+wave boxes with fall speed increasing by 0.3 per wave. Between waves show a 3-second countdown overlay. Add particle burst effect on catch using 20 small glowing spheres that expand outward and fade. Validate that score only increments on valid mouth-open catches, health never goes below 0, wave progression requires clearing all boxes, and the game ends showing a victory or defeat screen with final score and a restart button. Add subtle head idle bobbing animation using sine wave on Y position.
